A [[Poet/Legends|poet]] named [[Felloux]] wrote a '''work''' about the [[Battle of Mizra]], a [[New Sith Wars]] conflict between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that took place in [[1466 BBY]]. It would remain famous as of [[36 ABY]] and was mentioned in [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|''The New Essential Chronology'']] by [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]].
